title.en: Volume 380 Biographies 167: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, He Zhangling
title.raw: 卷380 列傳一百六十七 陈若霖 戴三锡 孙尔准 程祖洛 马济胜 裕泰 贺长龄

sentences.zh: 列傳一百六十七

translations.literal: Biographies 167
translations.idiomatic: Biography 167

sentences.zh: 陳若霖戴三錫孫爾準程祖洛馬濟勝裕泰賀長齡

translations.literal: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, He Changling
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, and He Changling

sentences.zh: 陳若霖，字宗覲，福建閩縣人。

translations.literal: Chen Ruolin, style name Zongqin, was a man of Min County, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruolin, courtesy name Zongqin, was a native of Min County in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十二年進士，選庶吉士，散館授刑部主事，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year of Qianlong he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, upon leaving the academy was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and was promoted repeatedly to director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-second year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and after completing his academy service was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, rising by stages to director.

sentences.zh: 束鹿縣民王洪中為人聚毆，訟不得直，自經死。

translations.literal: Wang Hongzhong, a commoner of Shulu County, was beaten in a mob assault; his lawsuit did not obtain justice, and he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongzhong, a commoner of Shulu County, was set upon and beaten by a crowd; when his suit failed to win redress, he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 若霖鞫得其實，被議敘。

translations.literal: Ruolin investigated and obtained the truth; he received a citation of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Ruolin investigated the case, established the facts, and was commended for his service.

sentences.zh: 秩滿當外用，仍留部。

translations.literal: When his term expired he was due for an outside appointment, yet he remained in the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired he was due for a provincial post, but he was kept on at the ministry.

sentences.zh: 數從大臣赴各省讞獄，以寬恕稱。

translations.literal: He repeatedly followed great ministers to conduct judicial reviews in various provinces and was known for leniency.
translations.idiomatic: He often accompanied senior officials on judicial review tours in the provinces and earned a reputation for clemency.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十三年，出為四川鹽茶道，擢山東按察使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing he went out as Sichuan salt-and-tea circuit intendant and was promoted to Shandong provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing he was posted as intendant of the Sichuan Salt and Tea Circuit and was then promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 調廣東，署布政使，以佐總督百齡平海盜，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Guangdong as acting provincial treasurer; for assisting Governor-General Bai Ling in pacifying sea pirates he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Guangdong as acting provincial treasurer, he assisted Governor-General Bai Ling in suppressing pirates at sea and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 調湖北，復調四川，就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hubei, then again to Sichuan, where he was promoted in place to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Hubei and then back to Sichuan, he was promoted on the spot to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Jiaqing he was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 水尾土州目黃金珠結內地奸民，殺副州目李文政，掠其家，鞫實，置於法。

translations.literal: Huang Jinzhu, native chieftain of Shuiwei Subprefecture, joined with illicit mainlanders, killed Vice-Chieftain Li Wenzheng, and plundered his household; the facts were established in investigation and he was punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Jinzhu, the native chieftain of Shuiwei Subprefecture, colluded with illicit mainlanders, murdered Vice-Chieftain Li Wenzheng, and looted his family; once the facts were proved in court, he was executed.

sentences.zh: 歷廣東、河南、浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: He successively served as governor of Guangdong, Henan, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as governor of Guangdong, Henan, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 浙省南北新關科罰無度，限以半正額為止，卹商而課裕。

translations.literal: At Zhejiang's northern and southern New Customs, fines and penalties were levied without limit; he capped them at half the regular quota, easing merchants while keeping revenue ample.
translations.idiomatic: At the northern and southern New Customs of Zhejiang, fines had been imposed without restraint; he limited them to half the regular quota, relieving merchants while keeping revenue sound.

sentences.zh: 修蕭山新廟堤，建盤頭以御潮。

translations.literal: He repaired the Xinmiao embankment at Xiaoshan and built a headwork to withstand the tide.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired the Xinmiao dike at Xiaoshan and built a headwork to hold back the tide.

sentences.zh: 次年，新林塘圮，親往勘，疏言：「新林塘舊為險工，今距海日遠，塘以外為灶地，外復為牧地，中有馬塘，足為新林屏蔽，宜補築以遏潮汐。

translations.literal: The following year the Xinlin embankment collapsed; he went in person to inspect and memorialized: "The Xinlin embankment was formerly a critical work; now the distance from the sea grows daily. Beyond the embankment are salt-pan lands, and beyond those pasture lands; Matang embankment lies between and is sufficient to shield Xinlin. It should be repaired to check the tide."
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Xinlin dike gave way; he inspected it in person and memorialized: "The Xinlin dike was once a perilous work, but the sea is receding year by year. Beyond the dike lie salt-pan fields, and beyond those pasture lands; the Matang dike in between can shield Xinlin. It should be rebuilt to hold back the tide."

sentences.zh: 疏通灶地各溝洫，引入牧地之莫家等灣以排泄之，即以灶地之土培護新林堤基。

translations.literal: Clear the various ditches of the salt-pan lands, channel water into Mokou Bay and similar inlets on the pasture lands for drainage, and use earth from the salt-pan lands to buttress the Xinlin embankment foundation.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed clearing the ditches on the salt-pan lands, diverting water into Mokou Bay and other inlets on the pasture lands to drain it off, and using earth from the salt pans to strengthen the Xinlin dike base.

sentences.zh: 西築橫塘以御江水。

translations.literal: Build a transverse embankment on the west to hold back river water.
translations.idiomatic: On the west, build a transverse dike to hold back the river.

sentences.zh: 責令灶牧各戶及蕭山、山陰、會稽三縣，分別修築。

translations.literal: Order the salt-pan and pasture households and the three counties of Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji each to undertake repairs as assigned.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the salt-pan and pasture households and the three counties of Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji each to carry out repairs on their respective sections.

sentences.zh: 」又奏修會稽、上虞等縣塘堤，並如議行。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized on repairing embankments in Kuaiji, Shangyu, and other counties, and all was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " He also memorialized on repairing dikes in Kuaiji, Shangyu, and other counties, and everything was done as he proposed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 湖南鳳凰等廳屯丁額多為官佔，失業者眾，悉清釐發還徵租。

translations.literal: In Hunan, many quotas of military colonist allotments in Fenghuang and other departments had been occupied by officials, leaving many unemployed; he cleared them all and returned the land for rent collection.
translations.idiomatic: In Hunan, many military colonist allotments in Fenghuang and other departments had been seized by officials, leaving large numbers without livelihoods; he cleared the records and restored the land for rent.

sentences.zh: 官入苗寨多婪索，或冒名詐財，嚴禁之。

translations.literal: Officials entering Miao villages often extorted greedily or fraudulently collected money under false names; he strictly forbade this.
translations.idiomatic: Officials entering Miao villages often extorted goods or collected money under false pretenses; he strictly prohibited such conduct.

sentences.zh: 又以屯地磽瘠租額重，為奏減苗租二萬餘石，免逋賦七萬餘石，苗民感之。

translations.literal: Because colony lands were poor and rent quotas heavy, he memorialized to reduce Miao rent by more than twenty thousand shi and remit more than seventy thousand shi of arrears; the Miao people were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: Finding colony lands barren yet heavily taxed, he memorialized to cut Miao rent by more than twenty thousand shi and remit arrears of more than seventy thousand shi, to the deep gratitude of the Miao.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，調四川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang he was transferred to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 中江覃萬典、犍為道士蕭來修等假神惑眾，捕誅首犯，不坐株連。

translations.literal: Tan Wandian of Zhongjiang and the Daoist Xiao Laixiu of Qianwei and others deceived the masses under pretense of divine powers; the ringleaders were arrested and executed without extending punishment by association.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Wandian of Zhongjiang and the Daoist Xiao Laixiu of Qianwei, among others, used false miracles to mislead the people; the ringleaders were arrested and executed without implicating their followers.

sentences.zh: 九姓長官司不諳吏治，奏請考試，獄訟別由瀘州及州判兼理。

translations.literal: The Nine Surnames Native Official domain was unversed in civil administration; he memorialized for examinations and that lawsuits be separately handled concurrently by Luzhou and the subprefectural judge.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftaincy of the Nine Surnames was unversed in civil administration; he memorialized for examinations of officials and that lawsuits be handled separately by Luzhou and its subprefectural judge.

sentences.zh: 四年，召授工部尚書，調刑部，兼管順天府尹事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Works, transferred to Minister of Punishments, and concurrently managed the affairs of the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was summoned to the capital, appointed Minister of Works, transferred to Minister of Punishments, and concurrently directed the Shuntian metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 文安縣地形如釜底，自道光初堤防衝決，積水不能耕種，議請急行修築。

translations.literal: Wen'an County's terrain was like the bottom of a cauldron; since the beginning of Daoguang embankments had burst, water accumulated and fields could not be cultivated; he proposed urgent repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'an County lies bowl-shaped like the bottom of a cauldron; since the start of Daoguang, burst dikes had left standing water and fields untilled; he urged immediate repair.

sentences.zh: 七年，命勘湖北京山黃家陵堤工，疏言：「下游災民籥請修治潰堤，上游居民謂口門下游乃襄河故道，復請廢之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to inspect the Huangjialing embankment works at Jingshan in Huguang and memorialized: "Downstream disaster victims urgently petition to repair the breached embankment; upstream residents say the area below the breach mouth is the old course of the Xiang River and again petition to abandon it."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was ordered to survey the Huangjialing dike at Jingshan in Huguang and memorialized: "Downstream flood victims urgently beg that the breached dike be repaired, while upstream residents claim the land below the breach is the old bed of the Xiang River and petition again to abandon the work."

sentences.zh: 河流經行二百餘年，捨此不由，而別尋二百年以前故道，其說殊謬。

translations.literal: The river has followed this course for more than two hundred years; to abandon it and seek a channel from two hundred years ago is an utterly mistaken notion.
translations.idiomatic: The river has run this way for more than two centuries; to leave this channel and hunt for a course abandoned two hundred years ago is absurd.

sentences.zh: 潛江、天門、漢川俱屬下游，而天門、漢川尤當衝要，何忍委之巨浸？

translations.literal: Qianjiang, Tianmen, and Hanchuan all lie downstream, and Tianmen and Hanchuan are especially critical points—how could one bear to abandon them to vast inundation?
translations.idiomatic: Qianjiang, Tianmen, and Hanchuan all lie downstream, and Tianmen and Hanchuan are especially exposed—how can we consign them to deep flood?

sentences.zh: 惟有開通江流，堵合口門，因勢利導。

translations.literal: One must only open the river flow, close the breach mouth, and guide the water according to its natural tendency.
translations.idiomatic: The only course is to clear the main current, seal the breach, and guide the water where it wishes to go.

sentences.zh: 胡家灣沙洲當下游之衝，以四十餘丈之地束全江之水，下壅上潰，理有必然。

translations.literal: The sandbar at Hujiawan lies in the downstream rush; to confine the entire river within some forty-plus zhang of ground causes backing up below and bursting above—this follows necessarily from reason.
translations.idiomatic: The sandbar at Hujiawan blocks the lower reach; squeezing the whole river through little more than forty zhang of width inevitably dams the flow below and forces breaches above.

sentences.zh: 今洲已衝潰，乘勢挑濬新灘，展寬水道，使江流無衝突之患，然後增築京山、鍾祥口門堤壩，再於潰口築石壩二，以護堤攻沙，庶可經久。

translations.literal: Now that the bar has been washed away, take advantage of the situation to dredge the new shoal, widen the channel so the river has no conflict of currents, then heighten the embankment dams at the breach mouths of Jingshan and Zhongxiang, and further build two stone dams at the breach to protect the embankment and attack the sand—then it may endure.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the bar has washed away, we should dredge the new shoal while the opportunity lasts, widen the channel to end conflicting currents, then raise the dike dams at the Jingshan and Zhongxiang breach mouths and build two stone dams at the breach to shield the dike and scour the sand—only then can the work last.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved his plan.

sentences.zh: 十二年，乞休歸，卒於途，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he requested retirement and returned home; he died on the road and was granted posthumous compensation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he asked to retire and set out for home, but died on the journey; the court granted funeral compensation.

sentences.zh: 戴三錫，順天大興人，原籍江蘇丹徒。

translations.literal: Dai Sanxi was a man of Daxing, Shuntian; his original domicile was Dantu, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Sanxi was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, though his ancestral home was Dantu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年進士，授山西臨縣知縣。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong, he was appointed magistrate of Lin County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong and was appointed magistrate of Lin County in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 連丁父母憂，嘉慶六年，服闋，發四川，補南充。

translations.literal: He successively mourned both parents; in the sixth year of Jiaqing, when mourning ended, he was dispatched to Sichuan and appointed to Nanchong.
translations.idiomatic: He mourned both parents in succession; when mourning ended in the sixth year of Jiaqing, he was posted to Sichuan and assigned to Nanchong.

sentences.zh: 歷馬邊、瓘邊兩廳通判，署資州、眉州、卭州，並有政聲。

translations.literal: He served as subprefect of Mabian and Zhanbian departments, acted as prefect of Zizhou, Meizhou, and Qiongzhou, and in all gained a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: He served as subprefect of the Mabian and Zhanbian departments and acted as prefect of Zizhou, Meizhou, and Qiongzhou, earning a reputation for sound administration in each post.

sentences.zh: 卭州民黃子賢以治病為名，倡立鴻鈞教，捕治之。

translations.literal: Huang Zixian, a commoner of Qiongzhou, under the name of healing founded the Hongjun sect; Sanxi arrested and punished him.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zixian of Qiongzhou, posing as a healer, founded the Hongjun sect; Sanxi arrested and punished him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，仁宗命送部引見，擢茂州直隸州知州。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Emperor Renzong ordered him sent to the ministry for imperial audience and promoted him to magistrate of Maozhou Directly Administered Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was reported, Emperor Renzong ordered him brought to the capital for audience and promoted him to magistrate of Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 歷寧遠知府、建昌道、四川按察使。

translations.literal: He successively served as prefect of Ningyuan, intendant of Jianchang Circuit, and Sichuan provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as prefect of Ningyuan, intendant of the Jianchang Circuit, and surveillance commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，遷江寧布政使，迴避本籍，仍調四川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was moved to Jiangning provincial treasurer; to avoid his native place he was again transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang he was appointed provincial treasurer of Jiangning, but to avoid his home province was transferred back to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，署總督，五年，實授，兼署成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as governor-general; in the fifth year he received substantive appointment and concurrently acted as Chengdu regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he served as acting governor-general; in the fifth year he received the substantive post and concurrently acted as regional commander at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 三錫自牧令洊陟封疆，二十餘年，未離蜀地。

translations.literal: Sanxi rose from magistrate and prefect by stages to frontier governor; for more than twenty years he never left Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Sanxi had risen from county magistrate and prefect to frontier governor, and for more than twenty years never left Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 盡心民事，興復通省書院，增設義學三千餘所。

translations.literal: He devoted himself to the people's affairs, restored the provincial academy, and added more than three thousand charity schools.
translations.idiomatic: He devoted himself to public welfare, restored the provincial academy, and established more than three thousand charity schools.

sentences.zh: 四川舊有義田，積儲備賑，穀多則變價添置良田。

translations.literal: Sichuan had long had charity fields that accumulated grain for relief; when grain was abundant it was sold to purchase more fertile fields.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan had long maintained charity fields that stockpiled grain for relief; when stores grew large, grain was sold to buy more fertile land.

sentences.zh: 三錫以歲久將膏腴多成官產，留穀太多，又虞霉變虧挪，差定三千至萬石為額。

translations.literal: Sanxi observed that over the years much fertile land had become official property, too much grain was retained, and there was fear of mold, spoilage, and embezzlement; he fixed a quota of three thousand to ten thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Sanxi found that over time much of the fertile land had become government property, reserves were too large, and grain risked mold, loss, and embezzlement; he fixed quotas between three thousand and ten thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 溢額者出糶，價存司庫，以備兇歲賑恤之用。

translations.literal: Surplus above the quota was sold, the proceeds kept in the provincial treasury for use in famine years for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Any surplus was sold off, with the proceeds held in the provincial treasury for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 又以蜀地惟成都附近俱平疇沃野，餘多山谷磽瘠，遇水沖塞，膏腴轉為砂石，因地制宜，多設渠堰，以資捍衛宣洩。

translations.literal: He also noted that in Shu only the vicinity of Chengdu was level fertile plain; the rest was mostly mountain valleys and poor soil; when water rushed in, fertile land turned to sand and stone; adapting to local conditions, he established many canals and weirs for defense and drainage.
translations.idiomatic: He also observed that only the Chengdu plain was level and fertile; elsewhere mountains and barren slopes predominated, and floods could turn good land to gravel; accordingly he built many canals and weirs suited to each place for defense and drainage.

sentences.zh: 新都奸民楊守一倡立邪教，造妖書惑眾，擒誅之。

translations.literal: Yang Shouyi, an illicit commoner of Xindu, founded a heterodox sect and made demonic writings to delude the masses; he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shouyi, a rascal of Xindu, founded a heterodox cult and wrote seductive tracts to mislead the people; Sanxi seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 越巂生番劫奪商旅，掠漢民婦女，捕駔黠者數十人置之法，救出被掠男婦，給貲安撫。

translations.literal: Raw tribesmen of Yuexi robbed merchants and carried off Han women; he arrested several dozen ringleaders and punished them by law, rescued the abducted men and women, and gave funds to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Raw tribesmen in Yuexi robbed travelers and abducted Han women; he arrested dozens of ringleaders and punished them, rescued the captives, and gave them money to settle their affairs.

sentences.zh: 屢被詔褒獎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly commended by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: He received repeated imperial commendations.

sentences.zh: 九年，因年老召來京，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because of age he was summoned to the capital and appointed acting vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on account of his age, he was summoned to the capital and appointed acting vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋致仕，未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Soon he retired; before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired from office and died shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其「宣力有年，官聲素好」，贈尚書銜，依贈銜賜卹。

translations.literal: An edict praised him: "He has exerted himself for many years and his official reputation has always been good"; he was granted the honorary rank of minister and posthumous compensation according to that rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him for "many years of devoted service and an unblemished reputation," granted him the honorary rank of minister, and awarded posthumous compensation accordingly.

sentences.zh: 孫爾準，字平叔，江蘇金匱人，廣西巡撫永清子。

translations.literal: Sun Erzhun, style name Pingshu, was a man of Jin'gui, Jiangsu, son of Yongqing, governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Erzhun, courtesy name Pingshu, was a native of Jin'gui in Jiangsu and the son of Yongqing, governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the tenth year of Jiaqing, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 十九年，出為福建汀州知府。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he went out as prefect of Tingzhou, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Jiaqing he was posted as prefect of Tingzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 寧化民斂錢集會，大吏將治以叛逆。

translations.literal: The people of Ninghua collected money for gatherings; high officials were about to prosecute them as rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners in Ninghua had pooled money for gatherings, and senior officials were ready to charge them with rebellion.

sentences.zh: 爾準訊無他狀，論誅首要，鮮所株連。

translations.literal: Erzhun investigated and found no other circumstances; he sentenced and executed the ringleaders, with few implicated by association.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun found nothing beyond the gatherings themselves, executed the ringleaders, and implicated almost no one else.

sentences.zh: 歷鹽法道、江西按察使，調福建，就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He successively served as salt-law circuit intendant and Jiangxi provincial surveillance commissioner, was transferred to Fujian, and was promoted in place to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He served as salt-law intendant and surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, was transferred to Fujian, and was promoted on the spot to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，調廣東布政使，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was transferred to Guangdong provincial treasurer and promoted to Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he was made provincial treasurer of Guangdong and then promoted to governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 河南邪匪邢名章等糾眾竄潁州，檄按察使惠顯率兵馳剿，格殺名章，殲其餘黨。

translations.literal: The heterodox bandit Xing Mingzhang of Henan and others gathered a mob and fled into Yingzhou; Erzhun ordered Surveillance Commissioner Hui Xian to lead troops in rapid pursuit, killed Mingzhang in combat, and annihilated the rest of the party.
translations.idiomatic: The heterodox leader Xing Mingzhang of Henan rallied followers and fled into Yingzhou; Erzhun ordered Surveillance Commissioner Hui Xian to pursue them at once, killed Mingzhang in battle, and wiped out his remaining followers.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩被災各屬，災甚者賑恤之。

translations.literal: He remitted and deferred taxes in all disaster-struck districts; where disasters were severe he gave relief.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted or deferred taxes in stricken districts and provided relief where the damage was worst.

sentences.zh: 先是有言賑務積弊，毋得以銀折錢，爾準疏其弗便，仍循舊章。

translations.literal: Previously there had been talk of accumulated abuses in relief work and that silver must not be converted to cash; Erzhun memorialized that this was inconvenient and continued the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: There had been proposals to reform abuses in relief work by forbidding payment of silver converted into copper cash; Erzhun memorialized that this would be impractical and kept the existing practice.

sentences.zh: 三年，調福建巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang he was appointed governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 延、建各屬山徑叢錯，多盜劫，以萬金為緝捕費，連獲賊首置之法，盜風衰息。

translations.literal: In Yan and Jian circuits the mountain paths were tangled and banditry frequent; he allocated ten thousand taels for pursuit and capture, successively seized bandit chiefs and punished them by law, and the bandit scourge subsided.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yan and Jian districts, tangled mountain trails bred bandits; he allocated ten thousand taels for pursuit, captured several chiefs and punished them, and banditry waned.

sentences.zh: 巡閱台灣，疏言：「台灣南北袤延千餘裡，初抵鹿耳門，可行舟楫。

translations.literal: On an inspection tour of Taiwan he memorialized: "Taiwan extends more than a thousand li north to south; at first one reached Lukang, where boats could navigate."
translations.idiomatic: On an inspection tour of Taiwan he memorialized: "The island stretches more than a thousand li from north to south; ships first entered through Lukang."

sentences.zh: 嗣增設鹿仔港，而淺狹多沙，內山溪水赴海，別開港在嘉彰間，曰五條港，頗利商船。

translations.literal: Later Luzai Harbor was added, but it was shallow, narrow, and sandy; mountain streams from the interior reach the sea, and another port was opened between Jia and Zhang called Wutiao Harbor, which greatly benefited merchant vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Later Luzai Harbor was opened, but it was shallow, narrow, and sandy; streams from the interior reach the sea, and another port between Jia and Zhang, called Wutiao Harbor, proved far better for merchant shipping.

sentences.zh: 又噶瑪蘭山峻路險，負戴難行，其地有烏石港、加禮遠港，可通五六百石小舟，皆宜設為正口。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Gamlan the mountains are steep and roads perilous, making porterage difficult; the region has Wushi Harbor and Jialiyuan Harbor, which can accommodate small vessels of five or six hundred shi—all should be established as official ports.
translations.idiomatic: In Gamlan the mountains are steep and porterage arduous; Wushi Harbor and Jialiyuan Harbor there can take small vessels of five or six hundred shi, and both should be made official ports.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 奏請噶瑪蘭收入版藉，設官治理。

translations.literal: He memorialized to bring Gamlan into the registered population and establish official governance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to bring Gamlan under civil registration and appoint officials to govern it.

sentences.zh: 彰化匪徒械鬥焚劫，旁近蜂起，全台震動，檄水師提督許松年剿捕，副將邵永福等趨艋舺，阻其北竄；

translations.literal: Bandits in Zhanghua fought with weapons, burned, and plundered; neighboring areas rose in swarms and all Taiwan was shaken; he ordered Naval Commander Xu Songnian to suppress and capture them, and Brigadier Shao Yongfu and others hastened to Mengjia to block their flight north;
translations.idiomatic: Ruffians in Zhanghua rioted, burned, and looted; neighboring districts rose in sympathy and the whole island was alarmed; he ordered Naval Commander Xu Songnian to suppress them, while Brigadier Shao Yongfu and others rushed to Mengjia to block a northward escape;

sentences.zh: 總兵陳化成以兵渡鹿仔，防其入海。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Chen Huacheng crossed to Luzai with troops to prevent their escape to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Chen Huacheng crossed to Luzai with troops to keep them from fleeing by sea.

sentences.zh: 爾準親駐廈門，遣副將佟樞等分往彰化、淡水，搜山圍捕，诇知賊黨煽誘日眾，移陸路提督馬濟勝守廈門，自渡海駐彰化督剿，賊首李通遁，捕得伏誅。

translations.literal: Erzhun personally stationed at Xiamen, sent Brigadiers Tong Shu and others separately to Zhanghua and Tamsui to search the mountains and encircle and capture; learning that the bandit party's incitement grew daily, he shifted Land Route Commander Ma Jisheng to guard Xiamen, crossed the sea himself to station at Zhanghua to direct suppression, the bandit chief Li Tong fled, was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun himself remained at Xiamen and sent Brigadier Tong Shu and others to Zhanghua and Tamsui to scour the hills; learning that rebel agitation was spreading, he left Land Route Commander Ma Jisheng to hold Xiamen, crossed to Zhanghua to direct operations, captured the fugitive chief Li Tong, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 令各莊舉首事，緝餘匪，閩人捕閩人，粵人捕粵人，以免誣累。

translations.literal: He ordered each village to nominate leaders to pursue remaining bandits—Fujianese to capture Fujianese, Cantonese to capture Cantonese—to avoid false implication.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered each village to name leaders to hunt down remaining rebels, with Fujianese arresting Fujianese and Cantonese arresting Cantonese, so innocents would not be swept up.

sentences.zh: 台人有與生番貿易遂娶番婦者，俗名「番割」，其魁黃斗乃等久踞三灣，潛出為盜。

translations.literal: Some Taiwanese who traded with raw tribesmen then married tribal women were popularly called "fan'ge"; their leader Huang Dounai and others had long occupied Sanwan and secretly came out to rob.
translations.idiomatic: Some Taiwanese who traded with raw tribesmen and married tribal women were called "fan'ge"; their leader Huang Dounai and others had long held Sanwan and raided in secret.

sentences.zh: 當亂起時，誘生番出山助鬥，遣參將黃其漢等分路偵擊。

translations.literal: When the disturbance arose they induced raw tribesmen to come out of the mountains to aid in fighting; he sent Colonel Huang Qihan and others on separate routes to scout and strike.
translations.idiomatic: When the uprising began they incited raw tribesmen to join the fighting; he sent Colonel Huang Qihan and others along separate routes to scout and attack.

sentences.zh: 番竄後山，士卒攀藤躡葛而登，擒黃斗乃等二十一人，斬以徇。

translations.literal: The tribesmen fled into the rear mountains; soldiers climbed by grasping vines and treading creepers, captured Huang Dounai and twenty-one others, and beheaded them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen fled into the back hills; soldiers climbed by vine and creeper, captured Huang Dounai and twenty-one others, and beheaded them as a warning.

sentences.zh: 爾準疏陳匪徒起事，由於造謠焚掠，非叛逆，當以強盜論；

translations.literal: Erzhun memorialized that the bandits' uprising arose from rumor-mongering, burning, and plunder—not rebellion—and should be treated as brigandage;
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun explained that the outbreak stemmed from rumor, arson, and looting, not rebellion, and should be prosecuted as brigandage;

sentences.zh: 淡水以北分黨報復，當以械鬥論；

translations.literal: north of Tamsui, factional revenge should be treated as armed brawling;
translations.idiomatic: north of Tamsui, factional vendettas should be treated as armed brawls;

sentences.zh: 焚殺有據者始坐闢，餘俱末減。

translations.literal: only those with proven arson and killing should receive the death penalty; the rest all received reduced sentences.
translations.idiomatic: only those proved to have burned and killed should face execution; all others received lighter sentences.

sentences.zh: 其脅從旋解散者，多所保全。

translations.literal: Many of those coerced who soon dispersed were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Many who had been coerced and quickly dispersed were spared.

sentences.zh: 又奏台灣北路至艋舺幾五百里，僅有守備一員，巡防難週。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that from Taiwan's northern route to Mengjia was nearly five hundred li, with only one garrison commander—patrol and defense could not be comprehensive.
translations.idiomatic: He also noted that the northern route from Taiwan to Mengjia ran nearly five hundred li with only one garrison commander, making thorough patrol impossible.

sentences.zh: 調南路游擊一員駐竹塹，並於大甲、銅鑼灣、鬥換坪諸處添駐營汛，改建淡水土城。

translations.literal: He transferred a brigade commander from the southern route to station at Zhuzhan, added garrison posts at Dajia, Tongluowan, Douhuanping, and elsewhere, and rebuilt the earthen fort at Tamsui.
translations.idiomatic: He moved a brigade commander from the south to Zhuzhan, added garrison posts at Dajia, Tongluowan, Douhuanping, and other points, and rebuilt the earthen fort at Tamsui.

sentences.zh: 頭道溪為生番出入總路，亦建土城，以屯丁駐守。

translations.literal: Toudao Creek was the main route by which raw tribesmen came and went; he also built an earthen fort there, garrisoned by military colonists.
translations.idiomatic: Toudao Creek was the main path used by raw tribesmen; he built another earthen fort there, manned by military colonists.

sentences.zh: 事平，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was given the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 七年，入覲，宣宗嘉其治台灣匪亂悉合機宜，迅速蕆功，賜其子慧翼官主事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he came to court for audience; Emperor Xuanzong praised his handling of the Taiwan bandit disturbance as entirely fitting the occasion and swiftly completed, and granted his son Huiyi the office of director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he presented himself at court; Emperor Xuanzong praised his handling of the Taiwan unrest as timely and decisive and granted his son Huiyi a post as director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 木蘭陂者，創自宋熙寧間，溉民田四十萬畝，築石堤千一百餘丈以御海潮，歲久傾壞，爾準道經莆田，親勘修復。

translations.literal: The Mulan Barrage was created in the Xining era of Song, irrigating four hundred thousand mu of farmland; a stone embankment of more than eleven hundred zhang was built to withstand sea tides; after years it collapsed; Erzhun passed through Putian on his route, inspected in person, and restored it.
translations.idiomatic: The Mulan Barrage, built in the Xining era of Song, irrigated four hundred thousand mu and was protected by a stone dike more than eleven hundred zhang long; long neglected, it had fallen into ruin; Erzhun passed through Putian, inspected it himself, and had it repaired.

sentences.zh: 工蕆，以宋長樂室女錢創陂實功首，建祠列入祀典。

translations.literal: When the work was completed, because the Song maiden Qian of Changle had truly been the first to create the barrage, a shrine was built and she was entered in the sacrificial registers.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished, he built a shrine to Qian, the Song maiden of Changle who had first built the barrage, and entered her in the official register of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 爾準治閩最久，諳悉其風土人情，吏民皆相習，政從寬大，閩人安之。

translations.literal: Erzhun governed Fujian longest, was thoroughly familiar with its customs and human feelings, officials and people were all accustomed to one another, his policy was lenient and broad, and the people of Fujian were at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun governed Fujian longer than any of his peers, knew its customs intimately, and enjoyed easy relations with officials and commoners alike; his rule was lenient, and the Fujianese were content.

sentences.zh: 九年，坐失察家僕收賄，鐫二級留任。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was demoted two ranks and retained in office for failure to supervise a household servant who took bribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was demoted two ranks but kept in office for failing to detect bribery by a household servant.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以病乞休。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he retired on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，贈太子太師，賜子慧惇進士，慧翼員外郎，諡文靖，祀福建名宦及鄉賢祠。

translations.literal: After a year he died; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; his son Huizhun was granted jinshi, Huiyi vice director; his posthumous title was Wenjing; he was enshrined in Fujian's shrines to eminent officials and local worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; his son Huizhun was granted jinshi status and Huiyi a vice directorship; he received the posthumous title Wenjing and was enshrined in Fujian's halls of eminent officials and local worthies.

sentences.zh: 程祖洛，安徽歙縣人。

translations.literal: Cheng Zuluo was a man of She County, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zuluo was a native of She County in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，授刑部主事，洊遷郎中。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fourth year of Jiaqing, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments and was promoted by stages to director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Jiaqing, was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and rose by stages to director.

sentences.zh: 諳練刑名，為仁宗所知。

translations.literal: He was thoroughly versed in penal law and became known to Emperor Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in penal law, he came to the attention of Emperor Renzong.

sentences.zh: 京察記名道府，久未外簡，以截取銓授甘肅平涼知府。

translations.literal: In the capital evaluation he was noted for circuit and prefectural posts but long went without outside appointment; through the special selection he was appointed prefect of Pingliang, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Marked in the capital evaluation for provincial posts, he went long without an outside appointment until selected for the prefecture of Pingliang in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 部臣請留，詔斥規避邊遠，撤銷記名，留部永不外用。

translations.literal: Ministry officials requested he be kept; an edict rebuked him for evading remote frontiers, revoked his noted name, and kept him in the ministry never to serve outside again.
translations.idiomatic: When ministry officials asked to retain him, an edict rebuked him for shirking a remote post, struck his name from the promotion list, and ordered him kept at the ministry with no further outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 久之，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: After a long while he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was promoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尋授江西按察使，遷湖南布政使，調山東。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Jiangxi provincial surveillance commissioner, moved to Hunan provincial treasurer, and transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, then provincial treasurer of Hunan, and was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，擢陝西巡撫，調河南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was promoted to Shaanxi governor and transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang he was appointed governor of Shaanxi and then transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 教匪硃麻子由新蔡竄安徽阜陽，捕獲置之法。

translations.literal: The sect bandit Zhuma-zi fled from Xincai into Fuyang, Anhui; he was captured and punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: The sect rebel Zhuma-zi fled from Xincai into Fuyang in Anhui; he was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 與直隸、山東、安徽、湖北毗連諸縣素多盜，撥庫帑五萬兩生息，為緝捕經費。

translations.literal: The counties bordering Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, and Hubei had long been rife with bandits; he allocated fifty thousand taels from the treasury to earn interest as funds for pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: Counties bordering Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, and Hubei had long been plagued by bandits; he set aside fifty thousand taels from the treasury to earn interest as a fund for pursuit and capture.

sentences.zh: 漳水決安陽樊馬坊，河流北徙，命大學士戴均元往會勘。

translations.literal: The Zhang River burst at Fanmafang in Anyang and shifted north; Grand Secretary Dai Junyuan was ordered to go and conduct a joint inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River broke through at Fanmafang in Anyang and shifted northward; Grand Secretary Dai Junyuan was ordered to inspect the site jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 祖洛週曆上下游，合疏言：「漳水自乾隆五十九年南徙合洹以來，衛水為所遏，每致潰溢。

translations.literal: Zuluo toured upstream and downstream and jointly memorialized: "Since the Zhang River shifted south and joined the Huan in the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, the Wei River has been blocked by it and often bursts and overflows."
translations.idiomatic: Zuluo surveyed the upper and lower reaches and memorialized jointly: "Since the Zhang shifted south to join the Huan in the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, the Wei has been dammed by it and repeatedly burst its banks."

sentences.zh: 今河流既分，不可使復合。

translations.literal: Now that the rivers have divided, they must not be allowed to reunite.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the streams have parted, they must not be allowed to merge again.

sentences.zh: 議於樊馬坊上下距洹水最近處，及南岸衝決成溝，並築土壩，使二河分流，冀減漫溢之勢。

translations.literal: It was proposed to build earthen dams at the points nearest the Huan above and below Fanmafang and where the south bank had burst into a gully, so the two rivers would divide their flow and hopefully reduce flooding.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed earthen dams at the points closest to the Huan above and below Fanmafang and where the south bank had torn into a gully, so the two rivers would run separately and ease the flooding.

sentences.zh: 」至四年春，積水消涸，地形顯露。

translations.literal: " By the spring of the fourth year the standing water had drained and the terrain was revealed.
translations.idiomatic: " By the spring of the fourth year the floodwaters had subsided and the ground lay exposed.

sentences.zh: 田市之北，漫水與溝隔斷，不能引歸正河。

translations.literal: North of Tianshi, floodwater was cut off from the gully and could not be led back to the main river.
translations.idiomatic: North of Tianshi, floodwater was cut off from the channel and could not be returned to the main stream.

sentences.zh: 乃就其上游龍家莊窪地抽溝啟放，复於內黃馬家窪開引河，添築田家營大壩，使溜勢南趨。

translations.literal: He then opened a ditch to release water from the low ground at Longjiazhuang upstream, further cut a diversion at Majiawa in Neihuang, and added the great dam at Tianjiaying to turn the current southward.
translations.idiomatic: He then cut a drainage ditch from the low ground at Longjiazhuang upstream, opened a diversion at Majiawa in Neihuang, and built up the great dam at Tianjiaying to drive the current southward.

sentences.zh: 自是漳、衛合併之患遂息。

translations.literal: From this the trouble of the Zhang and Wei merging ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the danger of the Zhang and Wei merging was ended.

sentences.zh: 虞城橫河、惠民溝，夏邑巴清河，永城減水溝，舊為豫東宣洩潦水要區，迭經黃河漫淤，濱河連歲被災，並疏濬之。

translations.literal: The Heng River at Yucheng, Huimin Ditch, the Baqing River at Xiayi, and the Jianshui Ditch at Yongcheng were formerly key areas in eastern Henan for draining floodwater; repeatedly silted by Yellow River overflows, riverside districts suffered disaster year after year—all were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Heng River at Yucheng, Huimin Ditch, the Baqing River at Xiayi, and the Jianshui Ditch at Yongcheng had long been the main drainage channels of eastern Henan; repeated Yellow River silting had left riverside districts in distress year after year, and he had them all dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，河南、安徽治捻匪從重典，嗣部議有所減改。

translations.literal: At first Henan and Anhui treated Nian bandits under severe statutes; later the ministry deliberated reductions and changes.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Anhui had first punished Nian bandits under the severest statutes, but the ministry later proposed lighter penalties.

sentences.zh: 祖洛疏言：「匪徒結捻，倡劫黨眾，一呼而集，其豫謀早在結捻之時。

translations.literal: Zuluo memorialized: "When bandits form Nian associations and incite robbery, the party gathers at a shout—their premeditation lies already in forming the association."
translations.idiomatic: Zuluo argued: "When bandits form Nian associations and incite robbery, followers gather at a single call—their conspiracy begins the moment they form the association."

sentences.zh: 新例以是否豫謀分別輕重，諸多窒礙，請復舊例。

translations.literal: The new regulations distinguish severity by whether there was premeditation, creating many impediments; he requested restoration of the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The new code distinguished penalties by whether a crime was premeditated, which created endless difficulties; he asked that the old rules be restored.

sentences.zh: 」並論匪徒拒捕及捕人治罪各條。

translations.literal: " He also discussed the various articles on bandits resisting arrest and punishments for arresting officers.
translations.idiomatic: " He also addressed the articles governing bandits who resisted arrest and the punishment of arresting officers.

sentences.zh: 又言：「獲盜究出舊案，免究從前失察處分。

translations.literal: He further said: "When a captured thief leads to old cases, waive investigation of prior failures of supervision."
translations.idiomatic: He added: "When a captured thief leads to older cases, officials should be spared penalties for earlier failures of supervision."

sentences.zh: 請遵嘉慶間諭旨，俾除瞻顧。

translations.literal: He requested compliance with the edicts of the Jiaqing era so that scruples might be removed.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the Jiaqing edicts on the point be followed so officials need not hold back out of fear.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 七年，丁母憂，服闋，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he mourned his mother; when mourning ended he acted as vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he mourned his mother; when mourning ended he served as acting vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋署湖南巡撫，調江蘇。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as Hunan governor and was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as governor of Hunan and was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 命查辦浙江鹽務，嚴定裁汰浮費章程，下部議行。

translations.literal: He was ordered to investigate Zhejiang salt administration, strictly set regulations to cut superfluous expenses, and refer them to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to investigate Zhejiang salt administration, drew up strict rules to cut wasteful spending, and had them sent to the ministry for approval.

sentences.zh: 台灣奸民張丙、陳辦等倡亂，命將軍瑚松額督兵進剿，祖洛專治後路軍需。

translations.literal: The illicit commoners Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, and others of Taiwan raised rebellion; General Husong'e was ordered to lead troops in suppression while Zuluo specialized in rear-area military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, and other ruffians in Taiwan rose in revolt; General Husong'e was ordered to lead the campaign while Zuluo managed rear-area supplies.

sentences.zh: 十三年，提督馬濟勝破賊，張丙等就擒，赴台灣籌辦善後事宜，劾戰守不力之都司週進龍等，褫黜有差。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Commander Ma Jisheng defeated the bandits and Zhang Bing and others were captured; Zuluo went to Taiwan to arrange postwar affairs, impeached Colonel Zhou Jinlong and others for ineffective defense, and dismissed them with varying penalties.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Commander Ma Jisheng routed the rebels and Zhang Bing and others were taken; Zuluo went to Taiwan to handle the aftermath, impeached Colonel Zhou Jinlong and others for failing in battle, and dismissed them with varying penalties.

sentences.zh: 改營製，增防守。

translations.literal: He reformed the garrison system and increased defenses.
translations.idiomatic: He reformed the garrison system and strengthened defenses.

sentences.zh: 優敘，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He received preferential citation and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He received special commendation and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 疏陳福建吏治，略曰：「安民必先懲蠹，不可以回護瞻顧而曲縱奸惡。

translations.literal: He memorialized on Fujian administration, saying in summary: "To pacify the people one must first punish corruption; one cannot shield and indulge out of favor and scruple while leniently indulging the wicked."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on Fujian administration, writing in part: "To secure the people one must first punish corruption; officials must not shield the wicked out of favor or fear."

sentences.zh: 閩省吏治無子惠之政，而務寬大之名，始因官之庸劣，釀成頑梗之風，今又因民之譸張，遂有疲難之勢。

translations.literal: Fujian administration has no policy of caring for the people but pursues a reputation for leniency; at first because officials were mediocre and incompetent a stubborn custom was bred; now because the people exaggerate and distort, there is a weary and difficult situation.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian had no policy of real benevolence, only a reputation for leniency; mediocre officials had bred stubborn habits, and now popular exaggeration had made governance weary and difficult.

sentences.zh: 官曰民刁，民曰吏虐，互相傳播，漸失其真。

translations.literal: Officials say the people are crafty; the people say the clerks are cruel—each spreads the other's charge and truth is gradually lost.
translations.idiomatic: Officials called the people unruly; the people called the officials cruel; such talk spread back and forth until truth was lost.

sentences.zh: 官不執法，幕不守法，因而愚民犯法，書役弄法，棍徒玩法。

translations.literal: Officials do not enforce the law, secretaries do not observe the law—thus ignorant commoners break the law, clerks manipulate the law, and ruffians play with the law.
translations.idiomatic: When officials would not enforce the law and secretaries would not obey it, commoners broke the law, clerks twisted it, and thugs mocked it.

sentences.zh: 必先懲不執法之官，然後能治犯法、弄法、玩法之人。

translations.literal: One must first punish officials who do not enforce the law, and only then can one govern those who break, manipulate, and play with the law.
translations.idiomatic: Only by punishing officials who refused to enforce the law could one deal with those who broke, twisted, or mocked it.

sentences.zh: 」於是連劾官吏不職者，略無假貸，吏治始肅。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he successively impeached negligent officials, sparing none, and administration began to be disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: " He then impeached negligent officials one after another without leniency, and administration in the province began to improve.

sentences.zh: 已革縣丞秦師韓京控提督馬濟勝矇奏邀功，並訐祖洛偏袒欺矇，命侍郎趙盛奎偕學攻張鱗按鞫，白其誣，師韓遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: The dismissed assistant magistrate Qin Shihan memorialized from the capital accusing Commander Ma Jisheng of deceiving the throne to claim merit and also denouncing Zuluo for partiality and deception; Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui and Provincial Education Commissioner Zhang Lin were ordered to investigate; his slander was cleared and Shihan was banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The dismissed assistant magistrate Qin Shihan memorialized from the capital accusing Commander Ma Jisheng of falsifying reports to claim credit and Zuluo of favoritism and deception; Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui and Education Commissioner Zhang Lin were ordered to investigate, found the charges false, and Shihan was banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，疏陳閩洋形勢，以漳州之南澳、銅山為籓籬，泉之廈門、金門為門戶，興化之海壇為右翼，閩安為省會咽喉，福寧之銅山為後戶。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he memorialized on Fujian's maritime situation: Nan'ao and Tongshan of Zhangzhou as outer defenses, Xiamen and Jinmen of Quanzhou as the gateway, Haitan of Xinghua as the right wing, Min'an as the provincial capital's throat, and Tongshan of Funing as the rear gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he described Fujian's coastal defenses: Nan'ao and Tongshan in Zhangzhou as the outer barrier, Xiamen and Jinmen in Quanzhou as the gateway, Haitan in Xinghua as the right flank, Min'an as the throat of the capital, and Tongshan in Funing as the rear guard.

sentences.zh: 巡緝守禦，全資寨城砲台。

translations.literal: Patrol, pursuit, and defense all depended on stockaded forts and batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol and defense depended entirely on stockaded forts and batteries.

sentences.zh: 就最要者四十四處，由官民捐貲修築。

translations.literal: At the forty-four most critical points, officials and people donated funds for construction.
translations.idiomatic: At the forty-four most critical points, officials and commoners donated funds for repairs.

sentences.zh: 十六年，丁父憂去官，服闋，引疾不出。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he left office to mourn his father; when mourning ended he pleaded illness and did not return.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he left office to mourn his father; when mourning ended he pleaded illness and declined further service.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，宣宗甚惜之，贈太子太保，諡簡敬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died; Emperor Xuanzong deeply regretted it, granted him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave the posthumous title Jianjing.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-eighth year; Emperor Xuanzong deeply mourned him, made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent posthumously, and gave him the posthumous title Jianjing.

sentences.zh: 馬濟勝，山東菏澤人。

translations.literal: Ma Jisheng was a man of Heze, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jisheng was a native of Heze in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以武生入伍，從剿川、陝教匪，積功累擢江蘇撫標參將。

translations.literal: As a military licentiate he entered the ranks, followed campaigns against sect rebels in Sichuan and Shaanxi, and by accumulated merit was promoted repeatedly to colonel of the Jiangsu provincial army.
translations.idiomatic: Entering service as a military licentiate, he campaigned against sect rebels in Sichuan and Shaanxi and rose by stages to colonel in the Jiangsu provincial army.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十八年，會剿山東教匪，擢河北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing he joined in suppressing Shandong sect rebels and was promoted to regional commander of Hebei Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing he helped suppress sect rebels in Shandong and was promoted to regional commander of the Hebei garrison.

sentences.zh: 道光初，擢浙江提督，調福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang he was promoted to Zhejiang commander and transferred to Fujian land-route commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Daoguang reign he was made commander of Zhejiang and then transferred to land-route commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 張丙等倡亂嘉義，台灣鎮總兵劉廷斌困守孤城。

translations.literal: Zhang Bing and others raised rebellion in Jiayi; Taiwan Regional Commander Liu Tingbin was besieged holding a lone city.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Bing and others rebelled in Jiayi, Taiwan Regional Commander Liu Tingbin was trapped defending the city alone.

sentences.zh: 濟勝率兵二千渡海赴援，戰於嘉義城下，大破賊，追至蘋港尾，擒斬甚眾；

translations.literal: Jisheng led two thousand men across the sea to relieve them, fought below Jiayi city, routed the bandits, pursued to Pinggangwei, and captured and beheaded many;
translations.idiomatic: Jisheng led two thousand men across the strait to relieve the siege, routed the rebels below Jiayi, pursued them to Pinggangwei, and killed or captured many;

sentences.zh: 進屯鹽水港，分兵搜剿，張丙及其悍黨先後就擒。

translations.literal: he advanced and encamped at Yanshui Harbor, divided troops to search and suppress, and Zhang Bing and his fierce followers were captured in succession.
translations.idiomatic: he advanced to Yanshui Harbor, sent detachments to hunt the rebels down, and Zhang Bing and his chief followers were captured one after another.

sentences.zh: 時命將軍瑚松額督師猶未至，詔褒成功迅速，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: At the time General Husong'e ordered to command the army had not yet arrived; an edict praised the swift success and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: General Husong'e, who had been ordered to take command, had not yet arrived; an edict praised the swift victory and awarded him the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 餘匪萬餘復來犯，俟其怠，擊之大潰，擒頭目賴滿等，追剿盡毀其巢，賊遂平。

translations.literal: More than ten thousand remaining bandits attacked again; waiting until they slackened, he struck and routed them utterly, captured the chieftain Lai Man and others, pursued and destroyed all their lairs, and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand remaining rebels attacked again; when they grew careless he struck, routed them completely, captured the chieftain Lai Man and others, destroyed their lairs in pursuit, and the rebellion was ended.

sentences.zh: 宣宗深嘉其謀勇，錫封二等男爵。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong deeply commended his strategy and courage and enfeoffed him as second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong greatly admired his strategy and courage and enfeoffed him as a second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 又以馭兵安靖，御書「忠勇廉明」四字賜之。

translations.literal: For also controlling troops and keeping the region tranquil, the emperor wrote with his own hand the four characters "loyal, brave, incorrupt, and clear" and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: For keeping his troops disciplined and the region quiet, the emperor personally wrote the four characters "loyal, brave, incorrupt, and clear" and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 召入覲，年逾七旬，猶壯健，溫詔褒獎，晉二等子爵，在御前侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: He was summoned for audience; though over seventy he was still robust; a warm edict praised him, promoted him to second-rank viscount, and appointed him to serve in the imperial guard before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to court though past seventy, he was still vigorous; the emperor warmly praised him, raised him to second-rank viscount, and appointed him to the imperial guard before the throne.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒於官，贈太子太保，諡昭武，四子皆予官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died in office; he was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, posthumous title Zhaowu, and all four sons were given offices.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office in the sixteenth year and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the title Zhaowu; all four of his sons received official posts.

sentences.zh: 裕泰，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Yu Tai was a man of the Plain Red Banner, Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 由官學生考授內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: From the Imperial Academy student he passed examination and was appointed Grand Secretariat secretary, then moved to reader.
translations.idiomatic: Selected from the Imperial Academy, he was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat and later promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶末，出為四川成綿龍茂道，歷四川、湖南、安徽按察使，湖南、陝西、安徽布政使。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiaqing he went out as Sichuan Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao Circuit intendant, successively served as surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, Hunan, and Anhui, and as provincial treasurer of Hunan, Shaanxi, and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Jiaqing he was posted as intendant of the Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao Circuit in Sichuan, then served as surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, Hunan, and Anhui and as provincial treasurer of Hunan, Shaanxi, and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 道光十一年，擢盛京刑部侍郎，調工部，兼管奉天府尹事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was promoted to vice minister of Punishments at Mukden, transferred to Works, and concurrently managed the affairs of the Fengtian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was made vice minister of Punishments at Mukden, transferred to Works, and concurrently directed the Fengtian metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 查勘科爾沁蒙旗荒地，奏禁私墾。

translations.literal: He inspected wasteland of the Khorchin Mongol banner and memorialized to forbid private reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed wasteland in the Khorchin Mongol banner and memorialized to forbid unauthorized cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十三年，召授刑部侍郎，尋出為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Punishments, then went out as Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was summoned to the capital as vice minister of Punishments and soon after appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，古州、黎平土匪起，擒其渠徐玉貴等誅之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year bandits rose in Guzhou and Liping; he captured their leader Xu Yugui and others and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year bandits rose in Guzhou and Liping; he captured their leader Xu Yugui and others and executed them.

sentences.zh: 調湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸標兵滋事，劾總兵向遵化、辰沅道常慶不職，罷之。

translations.literal: The Zhengan provincial garrison troops made trouble; he impeached Regional Commander Xiang Zunhua and Chen-Yuan Circuit Intendant Chang Qing for dereliction and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhengan garrison troops rioted, he impeached Regional Commander Xiang Zunhua and Chen-Yuan Circuit Intendant Chang Qing for neglect of duty and dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「苗疆屯田，嘉慶中道員傅鼐所經營，寓兵於農，籌邊良策。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Military colonies in the Miao frontier, managed in Jiaqing by Circuit Intendant Fu Nai, quartering troops among farmers, was a fine strategy for border defense."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Miao frontier colonies established in Jiaqing by Circuit Intendant Fu Nai, combining farming with garrison duty, were an excellent border policy."

sentences.zh: 治安日久，諸弊叢生。

translations.literal: After long peace, many abuses have clustered.
translations.idiomatic: After long peace, abuses had multiplied.

sentences.zh: 今鎮筸標兵因借餉倡亂，苗人遂生觀望。

translations.literal: Now the Zhengan garrison troops have raised trouble over borrowed pay, and the Miao have begun to watch and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Zhengan garrison had rioted over borrowed pay, and the Miao were watching events with uncertainty.

sentences.zh: 重以苗官苛刻，屯長侵欺，後患堪虞。

translations.literal: Compounded by harsh Miao officials and colony heads who encroach and cheat, future trouble is to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Harsh Miao officials and abusive colony heads made future trouble likely.

sentences.zh: 急應清釐損益，妥定章程，俾將弁兵練咸知經費有常，絕其覬覦，仍責成鎮道實力整飭，恩威並行。

translations.literal: It is urgent to clear accounts of gains and losses, properly set regulations so officers and soldiers all know funds are fixed and end their covetousness, and still charge the regional commander and circuit intendant to discipline in earnest, combining grace and severity.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts should be cleared, rules settled so officers and men knew funds were fixed and temptation removed, while regional and circuit officials were charged to enforce discipline with both kindness and severity.

sentences.zh: 」尋議定苗疆兵勇不准客民充補，預借銀穀限以定制，拔補備弁屯長，嚴絕苞苴。

translations.literal: " Soon it was decided that Miao frontier soldiers might not be filled by sojourners, advance borrowing of silver and grain was limited to fixed amounts, selection for deputy officers and colony heads was tightened, and graft was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: " Regulations were soon adopted forbidding outsiders to fill Miao frontier posts, limiting advance borrowing of silver and grain, tightening appointments of deputies and colony heads, and strictly forbidding bribery.

sentences.zh: 辰沅道缺，以湖南知府題升。

translations.literal: The Chen-Yuan circuit intendant vacancy was to be filled by promotion from Hunan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen-Yuan circuit intendant was to be promoted from among Hunan prefects.

sentences.zh: 並如所議行。

translations.literal: All was carried out as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調江西，復調湖南。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Jiangxi, then again to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Jiangxi and then back to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，湖北崇陽逆匪鍾人傑作亂，踞縣城，陷通城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the rebel Zhong Renjie of Chongyang, Hubei, raised rebellion, seized the county seat, and captured Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the rebel Zhong Renjie of Chongyang in Hubei seized the county seat and took Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 裕泰馳駐咸寧，檄按察使郭熊飛率都司玉貴等進剿。

translations.literal: Yu Tai hastened to station at Xianning and ordered Surveillance Commissioner Guo Xiongfei to lead Colonel Yugi and others in advance suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai rushed to Xianning and ordered Surveillance Commissioner Guo Xiongfei to lead Colonel Yugi and others against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 崇陽在萬山中，賊盡塞孔道，築砦抗拒，選精銳出賊後夾攻，分股犯蒲圻，連為官軍所敗，踞崇陽西嶺為負嵎計。

translations.literal: Chongyang lies among myriad mountains; the bandits blocked all passes, built stockades to resist, selected elite troops to strike from behind in pincer attack, sent detachments to raid Puqi, were repeatedly defeated by government troops, and held the western ridge of Chongyang in a cornered defense.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyang lay deep in the mountains; the rebels blocked the passes, built stockades, and sent elite troops to attack from the rear while detachments raided Puqi; repeatedly defeated, they held the western ridge of Chongyang in a last stand.

sentences.zh: 提督劉允孝迭敗之石盤山、黑橋，進毀其巢，擒人傑及其黨陳寶銘、汪敦族等。

translations.literal: Commander Liu Yunxiao repeatedly defeated them at Shipan Mountain and Heiqiao, advanced and destroyed their lair, and captured Renjie and his followers Chen Baoming, Wang Dunzu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Liu Yunxiao defeated them repeatedly at Shipan Mountain and Heiqiao, destroyed their stronghold, and captured Renjie and his followers Chen Baoming, Wang Dunzu, and others.

sentences.zh: 尋复通城，盡俘其孥。

translations.literal: Soon Tongcheng was recovered and all their families were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Tongcheng was soon recovered and their families were taken captive.

sentences.zh: 事平，加太子太保，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and awarded the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 時英吉利兵由海入江，詔募勇習水戰。

translations.literal: At the time English troops entered the Yangzi from the sea; an edict ordered recruiting braves trained in naval warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When British forces entered the Yangzi from the sea, the court ordered the recruitment of men trained in naval warfare.

sentences.zh: 裕泰仿粵艇造大船六、快船四，簡漢陽水師，每船百人，按旬操練。

translations.literal: Yu Tai modeled Guangdong craft to build six large ships and four fast boats, selected Hanyang naval troops, a hundred men per ship, drilling every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai built six large ships and four fast boats modeled on Guangdong craft, selected Hanyang naval troops at a hundred men per ship, and drilled them every ten days.

sentences.zh: 裁舊有巡船，以節經費。

translations.literal: He cut the old patrol boats to economize funds.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the old patrol boats to save expense.

sentences.zh: 荊州駐防每出營滋事，奏請飭地方官拘拿，報將軍秉公嚴懲。

translations.literal: The Jingzhou garrison often left camp to make trouble; he memorialized ordering local officials to arrest them and report to the general for impartial severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops at Jingzhou often left camp to make trouble; he asked that local officials arrest them and report to the general for severe and impartial punishment.

sentences.zh: 乾州苗竄擾，剿撫解散。

translations.literal: Miao of Qianzhou raided and harassed; he suppressed and pacified them until they dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Miao raiders from Qianzhou were suppressed by force and conciliation until they dispersed.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，李沅發倡亂新寧，踞城戕官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Li Yuanfa raised rebellion in Xinning, seized the city, and killed officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Li Yuanfa rebelled in Xinning, seized the city, and murdered the officials.

sentences.zh: 巡撫馮德馨、提督英俊往剿，复縣城。

translations.literal: Governor Feng Dexin and Commander Yingjun went to suppress them and recovered the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Feng Dexin and Commander Yingjun marched against them and recovered the county seat.

sentences.zh: 妄傳沅發已死，而賊竄山中，勾結黔、粵交界伏莽，勢益蔓延。

translations.literal: It was falsely reported that Yuanfa was dead, but the bandits fled into the mountains, joined hidden ruffians on the Guizhou-Guangdong border, and their power spread further.
translations.idiomatic: A false report claimed Yuanfa was dead, but the rebels fled into the hills, linked up with outlaws on the Guizhou-Guangdong border, and the revolt spread.

sentences.zh: 馮德馨逮治，專任裕泰往督師，與黔、粵諸軍合擊，數捷。

translations.literal: Feng Dexin was arrested and punished; Yu Tai alone was charged to command the army, joined Guizhou and Guangdong forces in combined attack, and won several victories.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dexin was arrested and punished; Yu Tai alone was put in command, joined forces from Guizhou and Guangdong, and won several victories.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，搜剿山內，擒殲多名。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year he searched and suppressed within the mountains, capturing and killing many.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirtieth year he scoured the mountains, capturing and killing many rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊竄永福草奚塘，四面抄圍，漸窮蹙。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Caoxitang in Yongfu; surrounded on all sides, they were gradually cornered.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Caoxitang in Yongfu, were surrounded on all sides, and grew desperate.

sentences.zh: 裕泰度賊不南趨廣西全州，即入新寧瑤峒，令提督向榮由武岡進屯廣西懷遠，遇賊擊破之。

translations.literal: Yu Tai judged that if the bandits did not hurry south toward Quanzhou, Guangxi, they would enter the Yao passes of Xinning; he ordered Commander Xiang Rong to advance from Wugang and encamp at Huaiyuan, Guangxi, where he met the bandits and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai reckoned that if the rebels did not flee south to Quanzhou in Guangxi, they would enter the Yao passes of Xinning; he ordered Commander Xiang Rong to advance from Wugang and encamp at Huaiyuan in Guangxi, where he met and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊退踞金峰嶺，分三路進擊於深箐陡石間，斬獲殆盡，沅發就擒，晉太子太傅。

translations.literal: The bandits retreated to hold Jinfeng Ridge; attacking in three columns through deep ravines and steep rocks, nearly all were killed or captured, Yuanfa was taken, and Yu Tai was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back to Jinfeng Ridge; attacking in three columns through deep ravines and steep rocks, the army killed or captured nearly all of them, Yuanfa was taken, and Yu Tai was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋調閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，調陝甘，入覲，卒，優詔以尚書例賜卹，諡莊毅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu, came for audience, and died; a gracious edict granted posthumous compensation at ministerial rank and the posthumous title Zhuangyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu, presented himself at court, and died; the emperor granted posthumous compensation at ministerial rank and the posthumous title Zhuangyi.

sentences.zh: 子長善，廣州將軍；

translations.literal: His son Changshan was Guangzhou regional commander;
translations.idiomatic: His son Changshan became regional commander at Guangzhou;

sentences.zh: 長敘，侍郎。

translations.literal: Changxu, vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Changxu became a vice minister.

sentences.zh: 賀長齡，字耦耕，湖南善化人，原籍浙江會稽。

translations.literal: He Changling, style name Ougeng, was a man of Shanhua, Hunan; his original domicile was Kuaiji, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He Changling, courtesy name Ougeng, was a native of Shanhua in Hunan, though his family was originally from Kuaiji in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 高祖上振，官湖南司獄，卹囚有隱德，貧未能歸，遂家湖南。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Shangzhen served as Hunan prison superintendent; he showed hidden virtue in pitying prisoners, was too poor to return home, and the family settled in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Shangzhen had served as prison superintendent in Hunan; known for quietly showing mercy to prisoners, he was too poor to return home and the family settled in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 長齡，嘉慶十三年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷贊善。

translations.literal: Changling, a jinshi in the thirteenth year of Jiaqing, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and moved to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Changling passed the jinshi examination in the thirteenth year of Jiaqing, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a compiler, and was later made a tutor.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，出為江西南昌知府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he went out as prefect of Nanchang, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he was posted as prefect of Nanchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 歷山東兗沂曹濟道、江蘇按察使，就遷布政使，佐巡撫陶澍創行海運。

translations.literal: He successively served as Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji Circuit intendant of Shandong and Jiangsu provincial surveillance commissioner, was promoted in place to provincial treasurer, and assisted Governor Tao Shu in inaugurating sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: He served as intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji Circuit in Shandong and as surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu, was promoted on the spot to provincial treasurer, and helped Governor Tao Shu inaugurate grain transport by sea.

sentences.zh: 調山東。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 七年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 臨清州教匪馬進忠為逆伏誅，復有揭帖偽立名號，刻期舉事，臚列旁州縣民名數百。

translations.literal: The sect bandit Ma Jinzhong of Linqing Prefecture was executed as a rebel; afterward placards falsely set up titles, fixed a date for action, and listed by name hundreds of commoners from neighboring prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The sect rebel Ma Jinzhong of Linqing was executed for treason; afterward anonymous placards invented titles, set a date for revolt, and named hundreds of people in neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 長齡曰：「謀不軌詎以姓名月日告？

translations.literal: Changling said: "Would those plotting treason announce their names and the month and day?"
translations.idiomatic: Changling said, "Would conspirators publish their names and the date of their plot?"

sentences.zh: 此移禍也。

translations.literal: This is shifting calamity onto others.
translations.idiomatic: This is an attempt to shift blame onto others.

sentences.zh: 」诇知果出邀功者，欲藉興大獄，遂置不問。

translations.literal: " Investigation showed it truly came from those seeking credit who wished to use it to launch a major case; he therefore let the matter drop.
translations.idiomatic: " Investigation showed it came from men seeking credit who hoped to provoke a major prosecution; he let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 調江寧布政使，乞歸養親。

translations.literal: Transferred to Jiangning provincial treasurer, he requested leave to return and support his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to provincial treasurer of Jiangning, he asked to retire and care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 十五年，母喪服闋，補福建布攻使，調直隸。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when mourning for his mother ended, he was appointed Fujian provincial treasurer and transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when mourning for his mother ended, he was appointed provincial treasurer of Fujian and transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 黔民苦訟累而多盜，以聽斷緝捕課吏，設旬報為考覈。

translations.literal: The people of Qian suffered from litigation burdens and there were many bandits; he assessed officials on adjudication and pursuit, and established ten-day reports for evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: The Guizhou people were burdened by lawsuits and banditry was rife; he graded officials on their judgments and captures and required ten-day progress reports for evaluation.

sentences.zh: 十八年，仁懷奸民穆繼賢糾四川綦江匪肆劫，遣兵與川軍會剿，焚其巢，首從並就殲擒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the illicit commoner Mu Jixian of Renhuai joined bandits of Qijiang, Sichuan, in plunder; troops were sent to join Sichuan forces in joint suppression, their lair was burned, and leaders and followers were annihilated and captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the rascal Mu Jixian of Renhuai joined bandits from Qijiang in Sichuan in raiding; he sent troops to join the Sichuan army, burned their stronghold, and killed or captured leaders and followers alike.

sentences.zh: 郎岱、普安、清鎮諸縣多種罌粟，拔除申禁，勸民種木棉，玉屏、婺川皆有成效。

translations.literal: In Langdai, Pu'an, Qingzhen, and other counties poppies were widely planted; he uprooted them and proclaimed the ban, urged the people to plant cotton, and Yuping and Wuchuan both saw results.
translations.idiomatic: In Langdai, Pu'an, Qingzhen, and other counties poppies were widely grown; he uprooted the crops, enforced the ban, urged people to plant cotton, and achieved good results in Yuping and Wuchuan.

sentences.zh: 黔省安置流犯三千餘人，與苗民錯處，釁隙易生，疏請改發新疆；
